approval.note: Trump job approval, net (approve minus disapprove): average of the RealClearPolling (-22.1) and Silver Bulletin (-24.3) nets as of Oct 26-28, 2026 (-23.2, rounded to the nearest 0.5: -23.0); unchanged from Oct 27. FiftyPlusOne's Oct 27 average (35.2/62.0) and Cook's tracker (36.4% approve, Oct 27) are checks.
sources: Silver Bulletin average, updated Oct 26: net -24.3 ('a new all-time net approval low')
Cook Political Report PollTracker, Oct 27: 36.4% approve

specials.note: Average Democratic improvement on the 2024 presidential margin across D-vs-R special elections since January 2025. The Downballot's Oct 20, 2026 update ('Special elections show Democrats headed for a year as good as 2018, if not better') remains paywalled with no tally visible (last checked Oct 28), so the Aug 19 tally stays; MultiState's 2026-only median (+10.4 across 37 contested specials through April) is a different measure and is not used

offyear.note: 2025 governor margin minus the state's 2024 presidential margin
